title: Electron IPC & Preload — File Dialog, API Key Storage, Project Save/Load
description: Add IPC handlers to the Electron main process for: file open dialog (image import), API key storage using Electron safeStorage, project save/load to filesystem. Update the preload script to expose these APIs via contextBridge. Update type declarations for the exposed API. Ensure contextIsolation is maintained.
acceptance_criteria: IPC handler: dialog:openFile opens native file dialog for images (png, jpg, webp)
IPC handler: safeStorage:setApiKey encrypts and stores API key
IPC handler: safeStorage:getApiKey retrieves and decrypts API key
IPC handler: project:save writes project JSON to filesystem with save dialog
IPC handler: project:load reads project JSON from filesystem with open dialog
Preload script exposes all handlers via contextBridge.exposeInMainWorld
Type declarations updated in index.d.ts for window.electronAPI
TypeScript strict mode passes with no errors
completion_summary: IPC handlers for file dialog, API key safeStorage, project save/load with typed preload API
